scope: Author model architectures under an explicitly adapted common optimization and pseudo-validation protocol; not original-paper score reproduction.

ddnet.paper_title: Change Detection in Synthetic Aperture Radar Images Using a Dual-Domain Network
ddnet.native_protocol: Per-pair transductive pseudo-label training; HFCM 1/1.5/2; train reliable 1/2; predict only uncertain 1.5; remove changed components <=20 pixels.
ddnet.common_pseudo_support: Yes, supplied image-only 1/1.5/2 mask can replace training labels; must label the run as a common-pseudo adaptation.
ddnet.license: No explicit code license found; internal research use only, do not claim MIT/Apache or grant redistribution rights.
caveats: CUDA-only temporary tensors in MRC and DCT; use logical cuda:0.
DCT intentionally detaches and transfers each patch to OpenCV on CPU.
Original sampler excludes the final candidate in each class and assumes sufficient samples; the runner records its corrected deterministic sampling separately.

lantnet.paper_title: Synthetic Aperture Radar Image Change Detection via Layer Attention-Based Noise-Tolerant Network
lantnet.input_scale: Unscaled original intensity; [T1,T2,DI], zero-padded 7x7 center patches.
lantnet.native_protocol: Per-pair image-only HFCM pseudo-label training; GT only at final evaluation; <=20 component removal.
lantnet.common_pseudo_support: Yes, without changing model/loss; protocol change must be disclosed.
lantnet.license: No explicit code license found; internal research copy, not a redistribution license.
adaptations: Register the same idempotent diagonal gradient mask once, not again on every forward. Exact-gradient equivalence must be checked on A6000 before production.
caveats: Original forward accumulates hooks without bound.
Original notebook does not set a seed or use validation/early stopping.

camixer.paper_title: Convolution and Attention Mixer for Synthetic Aperture Radar Image Change Detection
camixer.native_optimizer: Adam, batch=128; original notebook configuration retained as source
camixer.input_scale: Unscaled original intensity; [T1,T2,DI], zero-padded 9x9 center patches.
camixer.native_protocol: Image-only HFCM pseudo-label training; uncertain-only neural inference followed by <=20 component removal.
camixer.common_pseudo_support: Yes, without changing the author model; native and common-pseudo results must remain separate.
camixer.license: No explicit code license found. The paper's CC-BY license is not a code license.
caveats: The notebook declares depth=6 but the author ViT contains one Attention object; do not invent six blocks.
A fresh namespace and vit instance is created per model to avoid cross-run weight sharing.

mddnet.paper_title: Modified Dual Domain Network for SAR Change Detection
mddnet.gap: No verified author implementation located. Same-name GitHub repositories found concern potatoes, monocular depth, brain data or cervical lesions, not this paper. Constructor, patch size, full preprocessing, loss, dependencies and code license remain unverified.
mddnet.common_pseudo_support: Conceptually plausible from abstract's pre-classification training, but unverified without source. Do not substitute an approximate DDNet+ASPP model.

wbanet.paper_title: Wavelet-based Bi-dimensional Aggregation Network for SAR Image Change Detection
wbanet.native_optimizer: Adam lr=0.005, batch=128; scheduler constructed but not stepped in selected notebook
wbanet.license: No explicit code license found; do not grant redistribution rights.
adaptations: Only explicit torch.float16 and .half() casts become float32/.float(); transformed AST hash is recorded. No gradient-path or architecture repairs.
caveats: Author code detaches WaveAttention.reduce output through torch.tensor; retained.
Alternative first-author xuwayyy/WBANet commit 9f383ecb216b7ddffe6c5fcf7cc5ae6efdfe2215 also uses half, and changes dropout plus sampling; it is NOT silently substituted.
Wavelet filters are author-defined fixed buffers, not learnable parameters; their gradient semantics are retained.
Code depth parameter is unused; do not add layers to match a paper interpretation.
wbanet.common_pseudo_support: Yes structurally; retain confidence values if using native uncertain-only inference.

ihmeida.paper_title: High-Confidence Clustering and Lightweight U-Net for SAR Change Detection
ihmeida.gap: Exact title/DOI identified, but no verified author Mini-U-Net implementation, frozen preprocessing/loss or license located. The author's WASNet repository is a different method and cannot replace this entry.
ihmeida.common_pseudo_support: Unknown until the actual Mini-U-Net source and high-confidence FCM protocol are obtained.

sarcdnet.paper_title: SARCDNet-an enhanced deep learning network for change detection from bi-temporal SAR images
sarcdnet.availability_quote: The python code of SARCDNet model is available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.
sarcdnet.gap: Primary article provides a public data repository but not the model code. No author has been contacted and no external message is authorized by this audit.
sarcdnet.common_pseudo_support: Article states separate per-image-pair pseudo-label generation/training, but exact adapter cannot be verified without code.

wasnet.paper_title: Speckle-robust SAR image change detection for real-world monitoring using learnable wavelet transforms and attention
wasnet.loss: Original mse_kl_loss: alpha=.9, epsilon=.05 smoothed target, .9*MSE(softmax,target)+.1*KL(target||softmax)
wasnet.native_optimizer: Adam lr=0.005, batch=128, StepLR gamma=.75 per epoch
wasnet.preclassification: notebook cells 6,7: author SRAD with nonnegative sqrt safeguard and HFCM
adaptations: Only one explicit .half() operation is replaced by .float(); no architecture or gradient repair.
caveats: Earlier WASNet.ipynb actually instantiates class WBANet with a different SE-only block and interactive MSE+CE alpha. This audit selects the explicitly named 2026 MSE+KL notebook instead; it is not claimed to reproduce Table 1 exactly.

torch.tensor detaches the reduced branch; custom wavelet backward returns None for filters declared nn.Parameter, so they do not learn by backpropagation in this implementation. Retained and disclosed.
SEBlock(in_channels=8,reduction=16) has zero-width hidden layers. Retained, not silently repaired.
Original sampler leaves artificial zero samples when fewer than 3000 changed candidates exist; runner instead records the available real quota.
wasnet.common_pseudo_support: Yes structurally, but native source preprocessing and common-pseudo protocol must remain labelled separately.
